rule: 先列 Methods 下全部 Step 标题行，再按位置取前七个（禁用标题去重；Results 重列的同形标题不计），段＝标题行至下一同级标题前一行

steps.label: S1
steps.title: Step 1 – Defining the scope of the Intervention Setting Ontology
steps.input: dictionaries and the reporting guidelines of CONSORT, CONSORT-SPI, TIDieR and TIPPME（L11 段）
steps.output: a definition and overall topic for the ontology（L11 段）

steps.label: S2
steps.title: Step 2 – Identifying key entities and developing the preliminary Intervention Setting Ontology
steps.input: 100 published reports of BCIs（bottom-up，L13 段）与 existing classification systems（top-down，L14 段）
steps.output: an initial prototype version of the ontology（L13–L15 段）

steps.label: S3
steps.title: Step 3 – Refinement of the ontology through literature annotation, discussion and revision
steps.input: the results of the pilot annotations（L17 段首句）
steps.output: the revised Intervention Setting Ontology 与修订后的 annotation guidance manual（L17 段）

steps.label: S4
steps.title: Step 4 – Expert stakeholder review
steps.input: the Intervention Setting Ontology resulting from Step 3（L19 段）
steps.output: feedback from the expert consultation，以及据之修订的 ontology 与 annotation guidance（L22 段）

steps.label: S5
steps.title: Step 5 – Inter-rater Reliability of Annotations using the Intervention Setting Ontology
steps.input: 50 papers from Cochrane reviews 与另一组 50 randomised controlled trials（L24 段）
steps.output: inter-rater reliability assessed using Krippendorff’s Alpha（L24 段）

steps.label: S6
steps.title: Step 6 – Specifying the relationships between Intervention Setting Ontology entities
steps.input: common relationships from Basic Formal Ontology and the Relation Ontology（L26 段）

steps.label: S7
steps.title: Step 7 - Making the Intervention Setting Ontology machine-readable and available online
steps.input: a table of entities（stable level of development for initial release，L28 段）
steps.output: the Web Ontology Language (OWL) format version, stored on the project GitHub repository（L28–L29 段）
